column2: This campaign depicts Romanian participation in WW II. Romania was a client state of Germany and her international policy followed Germany's dictate s. Almost all the action occurs in the Eastern Front. Only some aerial combat with the Western Allies also took place. Romania was the only German ally briefed at the beginning of the invasion of the Soviet Union. Romania was governed during the perio d by a fascist dictator, Marshal Antonescu. The "Conducator", leader, was his official title. The best Romanian troops were foolishly lost in the Stalingrad and Crimea campaigns, thrown mindlessly against superior enemies without any regard for humanity or even military necessity. column2: Most of the heaviest action occurred within the period covered by the campaign (1941 - late 1945). Most of the casua lties in WWII occurred in the Russian front (3/5 of all others combined). The fighting was also extremely violent and continuous. I tried to reflect this in my scenarios.

column2: This campaign has been designed to reflect fast pace, heavy and continuous action. The armies are also significantly stronger than in reality. We all know the AI plays awful, so I have to change the scenarios in a way it can at least play a decent game. All the scenarios co n tain many over strengthened units, entrenchment, leaders, etc. In several scenarios the player will be allowed to deploy only a fraction of its army. The auxiliary units are very important because they contribute to the balance of power and at the same t ime provide some sorely needed capabilities. At the same time the game becomes more realistic. Successful campaign play requires minimum casualties or you will be out pretty soon. This fact leads to neglect of the auxiliary units and excessive caution concerning the core units. Here you cannot neglect your auxiliary units. You will need every single one of them or you will not win. I regularly reinforced them to keep them alive.
column3: 本战役旨在体现快节奏、激烈而持续的战斗。双方军队也明显强于现实。我们都知道 AI 打得很糟，所以我不得不调整场景，让它至少能打出一场像样的仗。所有场景都包含许多被过度加强的单位、工事、指挥官等。在若干场景中，玩家只被允许部署其军队的一部分。辅助单位非常重要，因为它们有助于力量平衡，同时提供一些亟需的能力。游戏也因此变得更真实。要在战役中打好，就必须把伤亡压到最低，否则你很快就会出局。这一事实导致玩家忽视辅助单位，并对核心单位过度谨慎。在这里你不能忽视辅助单位。每一个你都需要，否则就无法获胜。我经常给他们补充兵员，让他们活下来。

column2: Romania had mainly outdated, obsolete German hardware. Therefore, you are allowed to buy and/or upgrade to German (Soviet) equipment in some scenarios (4). Your army should be still Romanian, though. What worked best for me was to buy Romanian equipment, take good care of it and when it was experienced, to upgrade to Germ an (or Soviet). Even for a scenario it will show a Romanian flag. After the scenario is over the AI will not recognize it as Romanian anymore.
column3: 罗马尼亚主要装备的是过时、陈旧的德国兵器。因此，在部分场景中你被允许购买及/或升级为德国（苏联）装备（4 个场景）。不过你的军队仍应保持罗马尼亚属性。对我来说最有效的做法是购买罗马尼亚装备，好好爱惜，等它积累经验后再升级为德国（或苏联）装备。即使只是在一个场景中，它也会显示罗马尼亚旗。场景结束后，AI 就不再把它认定为罗马尼亚装备了。

column2: I did all the work, so, I have taken the prerogative of designing the kind of scenarios I like, full of action , and fast pace even if that strains reality. I hated the Winter Storm scenario in the original SSI campaign when it takes forever for those Romanian units to reach the last victory hex. I also do not like scenarios where after 3-4 turns you can put aut omatic pilot and collect a victory without any thinking. There are surprises lurking for you at every corner.
column3: 活儿全是我干的，所以我有权设计自己喜欢的场景：充满作战、节奏明快，即便这会偏离现实。我讨厌原版 SSI 战役里的冬季风暴场景，那些罗马尼亚单位要花无穷无尽的时间才能抵达最后一个胜利格。我也不喜欢那种打了 3-4 个回合后就能开自动驾驶、不用动脑就收获胜利的场景。每个角落都潜伏着给你的意外。

column2: One interesting concept used in this campaign is the idea of "defensive scenarios." There are several of these scenarios in the campaign. The main idea is that in order to win the player has to keep all the victory objectives held by him at the beginning of the game. If some are lost the player has to retake them to win. Some extra victory scenarios have been added to avoid a technical proble m . If you do not have victory scenarios of your own a victory can be achieved by taken any hex owned by your opponent. Of course, this fact can lead to premature victories. The premature victory can be avoided by adding at least a victory scenario for t he player. Normally I have added the supply hexes for the AI player.
column3: 本战役采用的一个有趣概念是"防御场景"。战役中有若干个这样的场景。核心思路是：要获胜，玩家必须守住开局时自己掌握的全部胜利目标。若有丢失，玩家必须夺回才能获胜。为避免一个技术问题，还加入了一些额外的胜利场景。如果你没有自己的胜利场景，那么占领对手拥有的任意一格即可达成胜利。当然，这会导致提前胜利。只要至少为玩家加入一个胜利场景，就能避免提前胜利。通常我会为 AI 玩家加入补给格。

column2: This campaign is not a historical campaign. I have a lot of respect for people who try to reproduce history, but this is mostly a fictional campaign. I de signed a movement, heavy and continuous action campaign. You start fighting from the first term and it will not be over until is over. I sincerely regret if you do not like this kind of scenarios, but everybody is entitled to his own taste.
column3: 本战役不是历史战役。我非常尊重那些力求再现历史的人，但这基本上是一个虚构战役。我设计的是一个机动作战、激烈而持续作战的战役。从第一个回合起你就开始战斗，直到结束才算完。如果你不喜欢这类场景，我真诚地感到遗憾，但每个人都有权有自己的口味。

column2: Even when t his is not a historical campaign every scenario has been inspired by a real event. Game limitations and my own taste imposed the departure from historical truth. For example, there were many air battles around Ploesti, but the game can not accommodate a n air battle only scenario, the attempts to evacuate troops from Sevastopol were too little and too late, the Romanian units in Stalingrad seldom had heavy guns and tanks.
column3: 即便这不是历史战役，每个场景也都受到真实事件的启发。游戏的限制和我个人的口味造成了与历史真实的偏离。例如，普洛耶什蒂(Ploesti)周边曾有许多空战，但游戏无法容纳纯空战的场景；从塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)撤离部队的尝试太少也太迟；在斯大林格勒的罗马尼亚单位很少拥有重炮和坦克。

column2: This campaign is not an endorsement of any political idea or of war. War is one of the most regrettable human activities. Before discovering Panzerg2 I was a master level chess player. I see the game as a more "colorful" chess.
column3: 本战役不表示赞同任何政治理念或战争。战争是人类最令人遗憾的活动之一。在发现 Panzerg2 之前，我是一名大师级棋手。我把这款游戏看作一种更"多彩"的国际象棋。

column2: I have organized implicitly the two armies following these guidelines. The two armies are distributed in Corps, infantry and tank corps. A tank corps has 4-6 units, 3-4 are tanks the others are auxiliaries (anti-tanks, AD, etc.). Each infantry corps has 4-8 units. At least 3 are infantry units, the others are artillery, anti-tanks, AA, AD, etc. Every unit represents a division or division-like formation. You start with a reinforced mixed Corps. Later on you will, explicitly or implicitly, build one Tank Corp and up to two Infantry Corps.
column3: 我按以下准则隐含地编组了这两支军队。两支军队分编为军，有步兵军和坦克军。一个坦克军有 4-6 个单位，其中 3-4 个是坦克，其余是辅助单位（反坦克、防空等）。每个步兵军有 4-8 个单位。至少 3 个是步兵单位，其余是炮兵、反坦克、高射炮、防空等。每个单位代表一个师或类似师的编制。你从一个得到加强的混成军开始。之后你会明确或隐含地组建一个坦克军和多达两个步兵军。

column2: Expect to find AA and AD units close to all the important points in the scenarios. I do not like those pesky planes. The AI will also receive planes as reinforcements. Mr. Dave Anderson originally proposed this idea.
column3: 在各场景的所有重要地点附近，你都会遇到高射炮和防空单位。我不喜欢那些讨厌的飞机。AI 也会得到飞机作为补充兵员。这个主意最初由 Dave Anderson 先生提出。
